messages:
maria-cs: quick ping 1 onboarding customers reporting degraded embedding relevance and some 502s during bulk import after this morning's runtime change. a few are in trial/renewal windows so we need coordinated comms.

jon-eng: looking now. initial repro on staging shows memory growth in the quantized decode path under large-batch workload.

taylor-sre: opening INC-2026-007; applying temporary throttle to large-batch ingest and diverting jobs to standby pools. monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-007 | status: investigating | priority: medium-high | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-007

maria-cs: CS needs a one-paragraph customer note: impact, current mitigation, ETA for fix, data safety statement, and goodwill offer. keep it simple for account teams.

jon-eng: tech note for CS: "root cause: memory growth in new quantized model during large-batch decode. mitigation: throttling ingest batches and rebuilding artifact. ETA for validated artifact and rollout: 48-72 hours; rollback possible sooner."

kevin-legal: wording check: say "we do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration." do not promise hours under 24. save outbound messages per retention policy.

olivia-cs: draft email for the 8 impacted contacts: 

Hi <Customer Contact>,

We wanted to let you know we observed reduced relevance for embedding results and intermittent 502 errors for some high-volume bulk ingest requests after a runtime update this morning. Our engineers identified a memory-growth issue in the updated model artifact and have applied temporary throttling to large-batch ingest pipelines while we prepare and validate a rebuilt artifact.

We do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration. We expect a validated fix and broader mitigation within 48-72 hours and will notify you sooner if we rollback or complete the fix earlier. As a goodwill gesture we will apply a small account credit to impacted onboarding usage and offer a priority technical review to help tune ingest parameters. Reply to schedule a review slot.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support

(Will post a concise portal status: "throttling applied; artifact rebuild in progress; monitoring success & relevance metrics.")

maria-cs: good. renewals AEs for top trials are looped in. @jon-eng please DM error-rate + relevance charts for those accounts.

jon-eng: will DM charts and timeline in ~15m. filing PR to add long-batch e2e test and memory metrics.

taylor-sre: mitigation stable after 45m; expanding rollout.

maria-cs: plan recap: 1) send targeted emails after eng signoff 2) post portal status 3) apply credits + offer review calls 4) RCA within 72 hours with root cause and long-term fix ETA.

kevin-legal: confirm CS will store sent copies in incident drive for retention and flag regulated customers for tailored compliance notes.

olivia-cs: confirmed; will upload sent emails and recipients.

maria-cs: thanks all 1 will send once portal post is live. we'll collect renewal sentiment feedback and prepare a short handoff for sales.
